subject: general
question: ______________ was the first Indian woman to write an autobiography and also the first to do so in Bengali in her book titled ‘Aamar Jiban’, which was published in 1876.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rassundari Devi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rassundari Devi** was the first Indian woman to write an autobiography.
 
• Her autobiography is titled **'Aamar Jiban'** and was published in **1876**.
 
• She was also the first to write an autobiography in **Bengali**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Aamar Jiban'** is considered a significant work in Indian literature, providing insights into the life of a 19th-century Bengali woman.
 
• Rassundari Devi's work paved the way for future generations of women writers in India.
 
• The autobiography details her journey of self-education and her thoughts on various aspects of life.
